Poison Cloud and the seven new Knight spells have detailed woodland spell models inspired by Mossvale creatures, with layered bark, mossy armor, antlers and fungal growth. Distinct casting poses, trails and impacts include a spinning ricochet shield and Adamant Guardian's stored-damage burst.

Starting auto attack with T or the mobile Attack button selects the closest valid enemy. Released hunter arrows still land after movement, switching targets, stopping auto attack or beginning another action; death and leaving the combat instance still clear them.

title: All 18 pet NFTs enabled
summary: The expandable Mossvale Pets collection is enabled with optional migration for original NFTs.
changes: All 18 current pets can use the expanded NFT collection. Eligible learned pets and finalized MOSS store-pet rewards can be converted from the NFT panel.
Original NFTs remain usable. Holders may optionally migrate each original token into the expanded collection; review the permanent lock and wallet gas fee before approving.
Future species can be added to this same contract. The existing OpenSea collection URL remains subject to a separate support-assisted migration.

title: Expanded pet NFTs and optional migration
summary: Expanded collection support covers all 18 pets and lets original NFT holders migrate when enabled.
changes: When the expanded collection is enabled, all 18 pet species support NFTs, including the eight new drop companions, Ashwing and Cinder Kit. New drop pets can still be learned normally.

You can explicitly convert a learned drop pet or eligible pet reward from a finalized MOSS store purchase. The review reserves the selected item or character unlock; an unpaid claim safely returns it after expiry. Refundable native-store rewards stay character-bound.

Original NFTs remain usable. Optional migration approves one original token, permanently locks it, and creates one replacement with the same token number and species. Wallet approval and network gas are required.
Future pet species can be added to the expanded collection without replacing its contract. Keeping the existing OpenSea collection URL requires a separate change by OpenSea support.

title: More reliable mobile loading
summary: Updated mobile builds give slow page loads and app switching time to finish connecting.
changes: Page loading continues while download progress advances. Opening a new page receives a fresh timeout instead of inheriting the previous page's deadline.
The page-loading timeout pauses while Mossvale is in the background. Returning gives the existing page time to finish; stalled loads still offer Reconnect and retry automatically.
These fixes require an app update through your installation channel. A game-server update alone does not change the installed mobile app.

title: Stronger fair-play and gold safeguards
summary: Account-level abuse protection and transaction checks help protect player progress.
changes: Repeated invalid requests now apply a one-minute account safety cooldown that survives reconnects and realm changes.
Unusually regular input is flagged for game master review without an automatic ban. Normal automatic attacks and pet pickups are excluded from this timing check.
Gold saves must balance recorded rewards, spending, transfers and escrow. Transactions with unexplained gold changes are rejected before they commit.
Inventory transactions now recheck account availability at their shared entry points and validate participating saves before committing.

title: Simplified Chinese and player country statistics
summary: Choose Simplified Chinese for the game and see aggregate player countries on the statistics page.
changes: Choose English or Simplified Chinese before signing in, at character selection, or in Settings → Language. The preference stays on this device and updates the interface without reconnecting.

Game menus, quests, abilities and system messages have a Simplified Chinese translation catalog with English fallback. Player names and chat remain as written; new names can include Chinese characters.

The statistics page shows unique active accounts by approximate connection country, deduplicated across realms, with an explicit Unknown count and coverage. New country history begins when tracking is enabled; historical countries are not inferred.

title: Quicker stack sales and valuable-item warnings
summary: Sell stacked items directly at merchants and review valuable sales before confirming.
changes: Select a stack at a merchant to use Sell all, with the quantity and gold payout shown on the button. Gathered materials retain their 1,000,000-per-sale limit.
Selling Legendary or Mythic items at merchants requires an explicit confirmation. Pets remain protected from merchant sales.
Auction listings for unlearned pet items or Legendary and Mythic items require confirming a warning before the listing is created.

title: Clickable quest boards
summary: Select quest boards directly from either side.
changes: Quest boards can once again be selected and right-clicked directly on the board from either side. E and the Interact button still work.

title: One MOSS voucher redemption per day
summary: Each account can redeem one MOSS voucher per day at Veyl’s counter.
changes: The limit is shared across all characters and realms on your account and resets every day at 00:00 UTC.
Saving a new voucher payout uses the daily redemption. You can still refresh its quote, collect, check or retry a saved payout after reaching the limit.
Veyl shows when the daily limit has been reached. Extra vouchers stay in your bags for another day. Gold merchant round payouts are unchanged.

title: Recover a waiting merchant wallet link
summary: Refresh your merchant requirements even when a wallet ownership prompt is stuck.
changes: While linking a wallet at the gold merchant, choose Cancel link & refresh to stop waiting and check the wallet already saved to your character.
Wallet connection attempts now expire even when the wallet has not returned an account. Late replies from cancelled attempts cannot submit an ownership signature.

title: Have your say at the polling booth
summary: Mossvale-style polling booths bring community votes to all six towns.
changes: Visit the green-roofed oak polling booth south of any town hall, or find it on the world map.
Read proposals, choose Yes, No or Skip, review your answers, and submit one final ballot per account across all characters and realms.
Results become visible after voting closes. A question passes with at least 70% Yes among Yes and No votes; Skip does not count toward that percentage.

The first proposal, “Stake MOSS?”, asks whether staking should be added to the game. It is a community proposal; staking is not available through this update. Voting closes on 27 September 2026 at 19:30 UTC.

title: Skill damage bonuses and companion movement
summary: Skill damage now benefits primary-scaling abilities, and combat companions walk around pillars.
changes: Fixed Skill damage bonuses from equipment and passive talents being ignored by Eagle’s Eye and other abilities that scale from Attack damage. The fix also applies to their channels, damage-over-time ticks, healing and shields; abilities already using Magic count the bonus once.
The spellbook explains that displayed power already includes equipped gear and applicable passive talents. All-damage bonuses remain included once, before skill multipliers and percentage bonuses.
Combat companions now walk around nearby pillars and cover when following you or pursuing an enemy instead of pausing against the obstacle.

title: Smoother movement around corners
summary: Move around obstacles without repeated snapbacks.
changes: Fixed movement updates cutting across obstacle corners and pulling you back while walking, sprinting or riding around them.

title: MOSS returns to item auctions
summary: List items for gold or MOSS in a refreshed Mossvale auction house.
changes: Browser players can choose MOSS again when listing items, alongside gold. Gold item sales retain their displayed seller fee, and Gold Exchange keeps its existing rules.
The auction house uses forest-green panels, brass accents and clearer trading controls.
Type quantities and prices directly. Background market refreshes keep your draft amounts while you prepare a listing.

title: Simpler gold statistics
summary: The gold section on the statistics page now focuses on Created gold.
changes: View gold created through gameplay over the last 24 hours, 7 days and 30 days, excluding administrative grants.
Removed the other gold figures from the statistics display.

title: Pet minting, vouchers and mobile sign-in
summary: The eight new drop companions gain optional NFT minting, with fixes for voucher verification and slow mobile sign-in.
changes: When minting is available, Fern Lynx, Moonveil Gryphlet, Cinder Salamander, Amethyst Terrapin, Blossom Jackalope, Lantern Sprite, Rime Red Panda and Crown Pangolin offer Mint NFT directly in Pets & Mounts and bag details. You can still learn an unlearned drop normally.

Already learned new companions can also be converted. Review the claim and confirm in your wallet; after minting, access follows NFT ownership. A claim that expires without minting restores the reserved companion after verification.
Fixed MOSS voucher verification failing when the public chain provider returned an old finalized block. Claims still require verified chain state and wallet confirmation.

Mobile sign-in allows more time for the app connection to become ready and preserves saved sign-in during a temporary startup failure. The native app also makes its connection available earlier while loading.

title: Smoother movement and lighter rendering
summary: Other adventurers move more smoothly, pet loot no longer interrupts walking, and large dungeons render less distant detail.
changes: Other players move and turn smoothly between realm updates, with steadier movement updates from your client. Teleports, seating and travel still reset their position immediately.
Distant players and mounts skip animation work outside your graphics draw distance.
Landscape and large dungeon scenery use smaller batches so off-screen terrain, trees and rooms can be skipped. Nearby artwork keeps its detail; defeated monsters stop animation work after falling.
You can keep walking while your pet saves collected monster loot and dungeon-cache rewards. Item actions remain protected until saving finishes.
Clicking or dragging player names no longer accidentally highlights their text.

title: The Verdant Revenant
summary: A jade spirit dragon mount haunts the final sanctum of Veilhaven Monastery.
changes: The Verdant Revenant levitates above the ground with relaxed dangling claws while idle and tucked legs while gliding, stepped jade scales, ancient brass armor, an animated spirit-flame mane, a downward-flowing tail that slithers left and right, and trailing emerald particles.

The Veiled Abbess has a personal 1 in 10,000 (0.01%) chance to unlock the mount for each living adventurer credited with her defeat in Veilhaven Monastery. Nearby party members must be within 14 meters of the boss.
A successful drop adds the mount directly to your character’s collection. It does not use a backpack slot or create a tradable item, and characters that already own it do not roll again.
Browse it in the Mounts journal. Summoning requires level 25 and riding training, and uses your learned riding speed.
Game masters can choose their own character, Give item, Mounts, then Verdant Revenant to grant it from the admin menu.

title: Pets fetch nearby loot
summary: Your summoned companion runs to nearby loot and unlocked chests, then returns to follow you.
changes: Pets now fetch your loot within 12 meters and collect it only after reaching it. You can stay where you are while your companion makes the trip.

Pets open unlocked dungeon and dream chests and collect your personal share. They also collect uncovered treasure-map chests after the guardian is defeated, while you are out of combat and dismounted.

Existing rarity filters, bag space, loot ownership, death animations and dungeon locks still apply. Pets need a clear, dry path and stop fetching if you move out of range. Treasure-map reward bundles stay intact when your bags are full.

title: Eight new woodland companions
summary: Meet eight more detailed companions while keeping every pet you already own.
changes: Fern Lynx, Moonveil Gryphlet, Cinder Salamander, Amethyst Terrapin, Blossom Jackalope, Lantern Sprite, Rime Red Panda and Crown Pangolin arrive with detailed new models.
The new companions replace the original eight pets in monster drops at the same sources and chances: seven at 0.1%, with Crown Pangolin at 0.01% from the level 40 Ashen Crown Titan world boss.

Moss Fox, Moon Owl, Ember Drake, Crystal Tortoise, Bloom Hare, Lantern Moth, Frost Cub and Golden Pig no longer drop. Existing pets keep their original models; unlearned copies in backpacks, banks and auctions remain usable and tradable.
Ashwing and Cinder Kit remain available through the store.
New drop companions can be learned and traded even when pet NFT claims are enabled. The original eight keep their existing NFT ownership rules.

After a temporary NFT ownership-check interruption, your selected pet returns once ownership is verified again. Selling or transferring the pet, or changing the linked wallet, still removes that access.

title: Offer gold to the traveling merchant
summary: Funded merchant rounds buy gold from the lowest asking prices, with editable offers and MOSS collection after closing.
changes: When a funded round opens, level-30 adventurers holding at least $25 worth of MOSS in a linked wallet can offer gold and set a price per 1,000 gold. Each account has one offer per round.
Merchant settlement checks no longer delay sign-in on realms without a configured payout service.
Offered gold is locked until you update or cancel before the deadline. Updates receive a new place in the queue for equal prices.
After closing, the merchant buys the cheapest gold first and pays each winner their asking price. Offers can fill partially; all unbought gold is returned, including while you are offline.

The round keeps a fixed USD budget while estimated MOSS changes with its price. At closing, one verified price locks every winning dollar payout into MOSS. Funding delays and later collection cannot change those amounts or the offer’s recipient wallet.
Each round starts manually. Adding MOSS to the treasury does not open bidding or start another round automatically.

The merchant now uses the MOSS price displayed by Pons for its $25 wallet requirement. Pricing failures leave the requirement unverified. Recent transfers still need final confirmation; round payouts and store pricing keep their existing references.

title: Clearer notices for planned updates
summary: Restart notices distinguish advance warning from the moment a realm needs to close.
changes: Scheduled updates still give at least five minutes of notice and save your character before restarting.
A pending update notice lets you keep playing while the realm waits to restart. If that restart is cancelled, the notice clears.

title: Refresh MOSS payouts while keeping your USD reward
summary: Voucher rewards stay fixed in USD, up to $30, while you can refresh the MOSS amount before collecting.
changes: Each voucher assigns a $5–$30 USD reward, capped at $30. The USD amount and payout probabilities stay unchanged when you refresh.

Choose Refresh MOSS amount before collecting to use a fresh ask-side price quote. This consumes no extra voucher and does not open your wallet. An actual sale may return less, and the token’s dollar value can change later.

Saved signed payouts remain collectible without a new price quote. Older payouts without an assigned USD reward keep their original MOSS amount. Submitted payments cannot be refreshed; use Check payout to follow their status.

title: Pets collect nearby gold and items
summary: Summoned pets now collect your personal loot, with a minimum item rarity you can choose in the Pets collection.
changes: Your summoned collection pet automatically picks up gold and items within six meters on a clear, dry path after the death animation.
Choose Uncommon, Rare, Epic, Legendary or Mythic as the minimum item rarity in the Pets tab. Your preference is saved for your character and applies to every collection pet.
Gold is always collected. Lower-rarity loot and items that do not fit in your backpack remain available for manual collection.

title: A new Pets & Mounts journal
summary: Browse your companions in a shared forest-green and brass journal with a collection list and a large, rotatable 3D preview.
changes: Switch between Pets and Mounts inside the same journal, and select any companion to inspect its model, ownership status and source.
Rotate the selected companion’s preview without summoning it or changing your preferred mount.
Learn, summon, dismiss and review available pet NFT claims beside the selected companion. Mount riding requirements and unavailable actions remain visible.

title: Distinct cities and services in every region
summary: Every city now offers banking and auctions, with reworked residential streets, detailed buildings and local townsfolk.
changes: Find a named banker and auctioneer in all six cities. Bankers access the same personal storage, and all auctioneers share the same market.
Regional residential districts now have different arrangements and connected paths, while homes, trainers, city gates and airship docks remain reachable.
Roads now join continuously at crossings and narrow lanes, follow doorway ramps, and use regional stone patterns with raised edges and recessed joints.
Building walls have raised stonework, timber framing and recessed openings. Clear window panes reveal real interiors instead of painted window panels.
Local residents wear regional colors, follow different walking rhythms and pause to look around or gesture.

title: Google and Apple sign-in on every realm
summary: Choose Google or Apple directly on the in-game sign-in screen in Europe, North America and Asia.
changes: Restored the Google and Apple buttons on the title screen and account page. In a browser, provider sign-in opens a separate window and returns you to character selection in the game.

title: Reliable MOSS wallet checks
summary: The gold merchant detects your linked wallet’s MOSS balance even when dollar pricing is unavailable.
changes: The merchant now shows the verified MOSS amount alongside its estimated dollar value. A temporary pricing failure keeps the balance visible and leaves the $25 requirement unverified.
Read-only requirement checks use a conservative bid estimate during wide market spreads. Store purchases, payouts and wallet ownership checks keep their existing safeguards.

title: Hunter companions lead the charge
summary: Combined Assault sends your combat companion into melee while you shoot from bow range, and other players can target combat companions.
changes: Combined Assault now commands your living companion to approach the selected foe and deliver its empowered strike on arrival. The hunter can stay at bow range.

Combat companions can be selected to see their health and attacked by opposing players in duels, the colosseum and arena matches. Their health is separate from their owner; defeating a pet does not defeat the hunter or award creature loot.

title: A gold merchant outside Greenwood
summary: A guarded merchant caravan has arrived just outside Lanternreach’s south gate in Greenwood.
changes: Find the traveling gold merchant beside his secured carriage, two horses and three armed guards east of the south gate approach.
Speak to the merchant to hear: "I'm waiting for a new shipment of MOSS." His checklist requires level 30 and at least $25 USD worth of MOSS held in a verified linked wallet.
Link your wallet and check both requirements inside the conversation. The merchant is still awaiting his shipment; linking and checking do not spend MOSS.
The escorts’ hands fit around their sword, halberd and crossbow grips.

title: Reliable touch page controls
summary: Hotbar switching and merchant pages respond once to each completed tap.
changes: Fixed mobile page controls advancing twice from one tap, including merchants skipping page two and the hotbar immediately switching back.
The hotbar bank button stays responsive when your character updates while a finger is held on its label or arrow.

title: Statistics connection recovery
summary: Improved recovery from database errors in the public statistics collector.
changes: Failed statistics database connections are discarded before retrying, preventing broken connections or lingering locks from delaying player-count updates. Missing readings remain unavailable rather than appearing as zero.

title: Panel scrolling fixes
summary: Window frames and backgrounds stay in place while scrolling long lists and item details.
changes: Fixed Friends lists and bag item details appearing outside their wooden frame while scrolling. The same fix keeps mobile Achievements, Bank, Loot and game master panels framed, and keeps inspected character sheets covered.

title: Map, merchant, arena and loot fixes
summary: Reachable mobile controls, safer colosseum seating, quicker saved loot actions and more reliable wallet and character loading.
changes: The mobile world map keeps its navigation card beside the map in landscape and below it in portrait. Map controls and the close button remain reachable on small screens.
Mobile merchants keep item quantities, Buy and Sell inside the screen in portrait and landscape. Lists and details scroll within the panel without hiding the transaction controls.
Loot and backpack changes use fewer database round trips, reducing delay on distant realms while still waiting for your progress to save.

Voucher collection can add Robinhood Chain to a compatible wallet and lets you choose your wallet again on retry. If a wallet returns an uncertain submission result, Mossvale checks the saved payout without sending another transaction.
Character models retry a failed or outdated cached download once using the current game build. Persistent failures still show the loading error and Retry option.
Fixed gaps along the colosseum’s outer wall that could drop spectators beneath the stands and trap them. Characters saved in those corners return to the terrace when reconnecting.

title: Offline talent workshop and mobile Store fixes
summary: Experiment with talent redesigns in a downloadable workshop, and browse the Store more comfortably on phones.
changes: The Talent Workshop at /talent-editor.html contains the current trees for all four classes. Edit talent names, descriptions, effects for each rank, positions and prerequisites, and freely allocate points while designing. Export and import JSON designs, or save a self-contained HTML copy that opens locally without installing anything. Workshop drafts do not change your game character.

Mobile Store cards no longer overlap reward details or checkout on short landscape screens. Portrait categories sit above wider cards, with checkout below the details. Restore purchases and checkout remain reachable by scrolling.

title: Redesigned talents and Beastmaster companions
summary: All four classes receive updated talent layouts, while Rangers gain permanent combat companions and new ways to build around Twinshot.
changes: Updated talent positions, prerequisites and rank effects across Ranger, Knight, Mage and Cleric. Valid builds from the previous layout receive a one-time free point refund so you can choose your new build.

Beastmaster replaces the Ranger’s Pathfinder branch. Tame Beast has a three-second cast, eight-meter range and ten-second cooldown, and saves one permanent combat companion from a living eligible creature at or below your level. World bosses, dungeon bosses and training dummies cannot be tamed. Taming leaves the wild creature in place and awards no loot; companion stats scale to its level.

Your combat companion can fight while your cosmetic pet follows. Recall, revive or dismiss it outside combat while keeping the saved tame. Heals you receive also heal your companion. Refunding Beastmaster or changing class deactivates the companion without deleting the saved tame.

Everlasting Bond makes a companion basic hit empower your next basic attack with 10% or 20% extra damage, then heal your companion for 5% or 10% of its maximum health. Combined Assault deals 1.5 times your basic damage plus 1.5 times your companion’s basic damage, with a sixteen-second cooldown.

Arrowstorm grants 5% or 10% basic-attack speed per successful Twinshot proc, stacking five times and refreshing its ten-second duration. The active Twinshot ability is now named Double Tap and retains its cooldown-reset and instant-cast proc.
Lingering Venom now extends Toxic Arrows to five seconds at rank one and six seconds at rank two. Reapplication continues to preserve the remaining poison damage.

title: A smoother sign-in
summary: Browser account sign-in stays on the Mossvale title screen, with fewer page changes.
changes: Sign in with email, create an account, reset your password and complete two-factor prompts in the game’s title screen. Your existing Keycloak account and characters stay the same.

Returning browsers check for an existing session silently. Sign-in uses one compact card, without a second background, logo or duplicate heading. If your browser cannot show the embedded form, Open sign-in page remains available.

Google, Apple and wallet sign-in now start from the same login card and finish in a separate sign-in window while the game stays open. Cancel or switch methods without losing your place; browsers that block the window can continue in the current tab. Native apps keep their secure system sign-in and encrypted session storage.

title: More dungeon creatures and level-matched loot
summary: The three themed dungeons now contain 36 distinct creature models, with varied attacks, aligned weapon grips and chance-based gear rewards.
changes: Each themed dungeon now has ten different regular enemy types and two unique bosses. New creatures include plague vermin, forge constructs, winged spirits and armed guardians, with their own Blender models and five animations. Square voxel anatomy, distinct faces, layered armor and clothing, and themed details match Mossvale’s visual style.

New enemies appear throughout the main route and optional wings. Distinct attack warnings include erupting vents, spectral formations and bursting scarabs. The expanded maps and protected arrival sanctuaries remain available.
Held weapons and curled fingers move together through the dungeon creatures’ animations, with staff grips positioned clear of the body.

Ordinary enemies have a 30% gear chance, side caches 40%, midpoint bosses 55% and final completion 70%. Boss rewards use a single gear roll and can award no equipment. Completion rewards refresh the corpse’s five-minute collection window.
When gear drops, side caches and midpoint bosses award Rare or better; final completion awards Epic or better. Each reward has a small chance of Legendary or Mythic gear.

New themed-dungeon gear matches its encounter level, capped at your character level. Equipment scales between the level-25, level-40 and level-50 sets. Existing items and the original four dungeons keep their previous rules.

title: Larger dungeons and exploration wings
summary: The Plagueworks, Emberfall Foundry and Veilhaven Monastery expand with three times the enemies and much larger branching maps.
changes: Each new dungeon begins with a protected arrival sanctuary where your party can prepare before stepping into combat.
All three new dungeons now offer at least three times their original walkable area, with connected side wings, alternate paths and guarded treasure destinations.

Each dungeon has 24 encounters: eight on the main route and sixteen optional exploration encounters. The Plagueworks and Emberfall each contain 93 enemies; Veilhaven contains 96. Each retains its two unique bosses.
Optional encounters remain available after the final boss while the instance is occupied. Unexplored encounters are not automatically cleared by reaching a checkpoint.
The dungeon map, minimap, movement boundaries, checkpoint and final return portal follow each expanded layout.

title: Distinct spell animations for every class
summary: All 129 Ranger, Knight, Mage and Cleric abilities now have individually constructed shapes and animation sequences.
changes: Each ability now has a separately authored Blender model and animation sequence, including the five talent capstones. Layered fire, fractured ice, carved metal, feathers, books and other solid forms give spells distinct silhouettes.

Frostbolt travels as serrated ice, Nova grows a branching snowflake, Pyroblast opens a furnace iris, Arcane Restoration pours an hourglass of light, and Knight, Ranger and Cleric abilities have equally distinct constructions. Casts, projectiles, area effects and impacts follow each ability’s combat timing and targets.

Soft radiance, moving motes, luminous trails and animated surfaces add magical detail. Bloom controls spell glow; Effects quality scales decoration while preserving essential combat cues. Spell power, range, targeting and cooldowns keep their existing values.
Twinshot gains a gold hotbar highlight and an Instant label while its instant-cast proc is active. The highlight ends when the proc is consumed or expires.

title: Weapons stay gripped during animations
summary: Hands and fingers now follow held weapon rotations throughout combat and movement.
changes: Fixed bows, swords, shields, staves, maces and tomes turning independently of the gripping fingers. All races now keep their hands aligned with held equipment, including during basic attacks, spells and gathering.
Fingers fit around each handle instead of intersecting a solid palm. Stowing equipment and returning from other animations restores the hand pose.
Mages now carry their staff forward and outside the body, keeping the standing staff shaft clear of the forearm and clothing.

title: The Plagueworks, Emberfall and Veilhaven
summary: Three new dungeons extend the adventure through level 55 with twelve new creatures, six distinct bosses and authored Blender environments.
changes: The Plagueworks opens at level 30: explore infested catacombs and toxic laboratories, confront Broodmother Vex, and destroy the Plague Abomination.
Emberfall Foundry opens at level 40: breach the volcanic forge, defeat the Anvil Warden and challenge Pyrelord Ignivar among runic stonework and molten machinery.
Veilhaven Monastery opens at level 50: pass through haunted jade shrines and lantern halls to face Bellkeeper Shen and the Veiled Abbess.
Each dungeon has eight encounters, two rune seals, four personal caches and a sanctuary checkpoint. Midpoint and final bosses have distinct attacks with visible warnings.
All twelve new creatures have their own Blender models and authored idle, movement, basic attack, special attack and death animations.

title: Gear drops through level 60
summary: Endgame equipment rolls now scale through level 60 while existing rarity chances stay the same.
changes: New rolled equipment extends level-50 gear into levels 51–60 with stronger base stats and level-appropriate bonus ranges. Drops remain limited by your level and the defeated monster’s level plus two; level-60 gear requires a level-60 character and a monster of at least level 58.
Overworld equipment rolls remain Common through Epic at the same chances. Legendary and Mythic remain dungeon-only, with rewards limited by the existing dungeon levels.

Existing equipment and fixed drop-table rewards keep their stats and levels. New endgame rolls retain their set bonuses and appearance, and preserve their level and attributes through upgrades, banking and trading.

title: Inventory drag recovery
summary: Interrupted item drags no longer leave the backpack stuck waiting for the drag to finish.
changes: Interrupted item drags recover on your next click without reloading the game, including bags opened from the auction house. Moving, swapping and equipping items remain usable through inventory updates.

title: Character, backpack and upgrades together
summary: Manage equipment and inspect or upgrade items from one profile screen while your backpack stays visible.
changes: Your character model, equipped gear and compact stats sit beside the backpack. Selecting an item updates its details and actions immediately, without opening another page or requiring Back to Backpack.

Upgrade opens in the selected item’s detail panel, with compact current-to-next stat comparisons and a horizontal row of required/owned gold and materials. Missing costs are highlighted so you can see what is needed.
Item lore is tucked into Details. Landscape keeps character and inventory side by side; portrait places the character above the backpack and item details in a bottom sheet.

title: Deeper combat specializations and tougher monsters
summary: Rangers and Mages gain signature talent mechanics and five new capstone spells. Ordinary monsters now grow stronger throughout leveling.
changes: Row-three Ranger talents add Twinshot with a rising chance after missed procs, or Toxic Arrows that carry unspent poison damage into the next application. Their capstones unlock a resetting Twinshot spell and a nearby poison detonation.

Mage specializations now build around repeating Arcane Missiles, Burning Heat that speeds spell casts and damage-over-time ticks, or Chilled targets that empower and reset Ice Lance. Row-five capstones add Arcane Volley, Combustion and Shatter.

Valid existing talent builds receive a one-time refund so you can choose the new mechanics. Capstone spells unlock through talents, appear in the spellbook and can be placed in either hotbar bank without buying a trainer lesson. Skill-tree arrows clearly connect the new same-tier prerequisites across desktop and mobile layouts.

Ordinary fighting monsters gain health and damage from level 2 onward, with stronger scaling through level 60. Dungeon health uses the same level curve before group and boss modifiers. Level-1 creatures, world bosses, training dummies, treasure-goblin escape encounters and reward formulas keep their existing values.

title: Gold economy and player-funded exchange
summary: New economy rules activate together after the coordinated realm update.
changes: The economy update protects 100 existing gold per account and removes 90% of the excess, including pending gold proceeds. Items, progression and paid entitlements remain.

On updated realms, reduced repeatable gold rewards make gold scarcer. Resources, loot, equipment and bags sell for half their former NPC values, rounded down with a minimum of one gold for sellable items. Crafting, flights, talent resets, boosts and class changes use the displayed gold prices. Campaign rewards, XP and rare MOSS vouchers remain.

New gameplay-item auctions use gold and burn a 5% seller fee. The browser Gold Exchange reserves player gold for whole-lot MOSS purchases, delivering net gold after finality and burning 0.5%. Existing listings and purchases keep their terms.

title: Collect MOSS vouchers from the mobile app
summary: Updated mobile builds can link a payout wallet and collect vouchers through wallet approval.
changes: Veyl now opens your selected wallet for ownership proof and voucher collection, then returns the result to the game app. Wallet sign-in and payout linking are separate steps.

Collecting sends the saved payout transaction on Robinhood Chain and needs ETH for the network fee. Cancelled or interrupted approvals keep the saved payout available; Check payout recovers a submitted payment.
Older app builds show update instructions instead of searching for browser wallet extensions.

title: Apple purchase preparation
summary: Apple purchases remain unavailable while store review is prepared.
changes: Payment setup now uses the same five-minute restart warnings and final saves as game updates. This preparation does not open Apple checkout.

title: See your completed auction sales
summary: Review your latest completed sales in the auction house’s Sold tab.
changes: The new Sold tab records your character’s latest 100 completed auction sales, showing the item, quantity, total price, currency, buyer and date. History starts with this update and follows you between realms; MOSS and ETH sales are recorded after payment finalizes.

title: Burned title retired from the store
summary: Burned is no longer available for new store purchases.
changes: Removed the Burned title and Titles category from the browser and mobile store. Existing owners can still equip the title in Achievements, and previous purchases continue to be delivered.
Store categories and item cards stay inside their panel on shorter screens, keeping the checkout controls clear.
The Store button stays inside the mobile Menu so it can be opened on phones and tablets.
On short landscape screens, scroll the store to reach its item cards and checkout controls.

title: Retry cancelled MOSS wallet actions
summary: Auction withdrawals and store purchases recover after wallet cancellation.
changes: Cancelling an auction-proceeds withdrawal no longer leaves the auction window busy after a market update. Retry Withdraw MOSS proceeds immediately; cancelling the wallet prompt leaves the proceeds available.
MOSS store purchases can be retried after more types of explicit wallet cancellation. Uncertain submissions still use Check delivery to avoid repeating a burn.
Voucher payouts keep track of a transaction that finishes submitting after you close the counter or switch characters, so returning to the original claim can recover its payment status.

title: More room for your controls
summary: Arrange your mobile controls, save more hotbar abilities and approach melee enemies with one attack action.
changes: Mobile controls can be rearranged from Settings → Controls. Drag the movement and combat groups into position, save the layout on this device or reset it to the default. Editing blocks gameplay input and keeps controls inside the visible screen.

Each character now has two saved banks of eight hotbar slots. Switch banks with the hotbar button or the new remappable shortcut; number keys activate the visible bank. Existing slot assignments and custom keybindings are preserved.

Right-clicking a selected PvE enemy, or tapping Attack on mobile, now lets Knight and Cleric characters approach it and start their normal auto attacks. Movement keys or the joystick cancel approach; Stop, Escape, target changes, death and disconnects stop it too. Blocked routes show a message. Selecting an enemy alone does not start movement.

title: Faster auction item delivery
summary: Wallet auction purchases now arrive when payment is processed, with safe rollback if the payment is removed from the chain.
changes: MOSS and ETH auction items are delivered at processed payment instead of waiting for finality. Gear can be equipped immediately; full bags keep the purchase reserved until there is room.
Purchased quantities cannot be consumed, sold, dropped, banked, crafted with or transferred until payment is finalized. Finalization unlocks them without delivering duplicates.
If payment is removed from the chain, the temporary items are reverted. RPC outages preserve them while checks retry, and delivery tracking survives reconnects and realm changes.

title: Mossvale player and auction statistics
summary: Follow live players, hourly activity and MOSS auction volume at stats.mossvale.world.
changes: The public statistics dashboard shows players online across Europe, North America and Asia, registered accounts, recorded player peaks and confirmed MOSS auction purchases.

Explore concurrent-player charts and unique active accounts per UTC hour, switch time ranges and download hourly history as CSV. Player history starts when tracking is enabled; missing realm readings are shown as unavailable.

title: Graphics that adapt to your device
summary: A short performance check selects the highest graphics quality that runs smoothly on your device.
changes: Auto graphics now runs a short check after you enter the world, trying High first and stepping down to Medium or Low until the current scene runs at around 50 FPS. It uses conservative settings while the world loads and quickly abandons a tier that performs very poorly.

The check ignores open menus and background pauses, saves its result for your next launch and can be repeated with Run performance check or Check again in Graphics settings. If later gameplay stays slow, Auto can lower quality without repeatedly raising it again.

Existing saved manual graphics choices are preserved. Choose Auto or Defaults to queue the check; changing a preset or any individual option returns control to you. Combat cues remain visible at every quality level.

title: Create and turn your adventurer
summary: A guided character creator with direct control of the preview.
changes: Character creation now uses four short steps: Class, Look, Colors and Name. The live woodland preview stays visible, and Back and Next preserve your choices without a long scrolling options panel.
Drag across the character preview to spin it, or hold either rotation arrow for continuous turning. This works in both character creation and selection; tapping the arrows still rotates one step.

title: A full-screen welcome on mobile
summary: Choose your adventurer against the living world, with clearer controls and more room on phones and tablets.
changes: The character selection scene now fills the screen on phones and tablets, with larger character previews and compact realm and entry controls.
Character lists scroll independently so selecting, creating and deleting characters remain within reach in landscape and portrait layouts.
The updated native app draws the game edge to edge while keeping controls clear of camera cutouts and the home indicator. This requires installing the new app build.

title: Smoother sign-in and backpack actions
summary: Keep routine rewards quiet and improve backpack actions, dropping items and returning to the game.
changes: Reduced database round trips and background polling so loading characters, saving backpack actions and changing regions spend less time waiting. Abandoned connection retries no longer claim an account after their socket has closed.
Movement during an item save no longer spams the purchase, auction or trade warning. A repeated action gets a single visible Saving your changes message while its save finishes.

Returning browsers remember to check their existing sign-in session. The updated native app securely remembers wallet and email sessions between launches; this part requires installing the new app build and signing in once.

Routine loot, gathering and combat rewards remain in System history without repeatedly replacing chat previews, adding unread badges or playing reward sounds. Level-ups and other milestones still announce themselves.
Dropping an item now uses a Mossvale confirmation with Keep item and Drop item buttons, instead of the Android browser popup. It clearly states that the item is permanently destroyed.
Unequipped starter equipment, including the level-1 bow, can now be dropped. Equipped gear and bags must still be unequipped first.

title: Realm connection recovery
summary: Recover from interrupted connections and change regions while characters are still loading.
changes: Changing regions before your character list loads no longer waits for a save confirmation from a session that has not joined.
If a region change cannot confirm your save, the game automatically reconnects to the original region so you can safely try again.
Background saves and account checks no longer build up a queue that can delay character loading or region changes, particularly in Asia.

title: Regional contracts and ranged combat fixes
summary: Complete the Elderwood patrol and keep your hits and loot when fighting at range.
changes: The Elderwood Reach patrol now asks for eight level-24-or-higher Woodland Slimes that spawn in the region. Existing accepted contracts keep their progress.
Killing an ordinary monster from long range now always grants the killing player XP, kill credit and personal loot. Nearby party sharing still uses its 14-meter range.
Moving, jumping or cancelling just after a spell finishes casting no longer interrupts its completed release. Movement still interrupts unfinished casts and channels.
Ranged auto-attack projectiles still hit after you move out of weapon range. Moving out of range pauses new auto attacks; melee swings still require contact range.

title: Change class with MOSS
summary: Burn $50 worth of MOSS to change your character’s class while keeping your progress and items.
changes: Activated the browser store’s class-change purchase on the updated MOSS burn contract. Existing store payments remain recoverable.

The browser store offers one class change for $50 worth of MOSS at the quoted price. The credit is ready when the burn is processed; choose and confirm a different class when out of combat and travel.

Class changes keep level, XP, quests, professions, gold and owned items. All learned abilities and talent choices reset on every swap, including switching back. The new class receives its starter ability and basic gear.
Previously equipped gear moves into your inventory, with overflow sent to the bank. If there is not enough combined storage space, the change waits and your credit remains available.

title: New places, fishing, dreams and character styles
summary: Explore Slimefen and Sugarbloom Orchard, cast a fishing line and discover dream worlds with more ways to shape your character.
changes: Added Slimefen and Sugarbloom Orchard, hidden curios and named gathering sites with shared claims and faster replenishment.
Fishing joins the gathering professions, with shoreline shoals, four fish tiers and catches you can eat outside combat or sell.
Resting in a reachable bed restores health and can lead to a private pleasant dream or nightmare. Collect keepsakes, wake at a portal or return safely when the dream ends.
Catfolk, Dogfolk and Lizardfolk join the character creator. Added four hairstyles, hair highlights, arbitrary colors and separate head, body, leg, shoe and back dyes.

Talents now grant 20 points by level 60. Existing allocations are refunded once, and builds can be reset outside combat. Class talents and two-piece and four-piece gear effects now support distinct spell styles.
Mage combat adds fire damage over time, frost shatter combinations and arcane executes. Repeatable core hard casts no longer add a cooldown after completion.
Your damage-over-time effects show remaining duration, out-of-range abilities show a red cue and objective arrows follow safe ground routes.
Updated the race, hairstyle and world prop models with detailed Blender assets.

title: Clearer pet NFT claims and cancellation
summary: Review a pet claim before reserving the drop, with clearer wallet cancellation and recovery.
changes: Pet NFT claims now show a review before reserving the drop. Your selected wallet stays with the claim.
Canceled wallet requests explain when an unminted drop can return after permission expiry and network confirmation; keep a free bag slot.
Pet inventory actions open the matching NFT claim, and Settings can be dismissed by clicking its backdrop.

title: Clearer item rolls and waypoint recovery
summary: Inspect your gear rolls and keep useful directions after Zeppelin travel.
changes: Open Roll details in item inspection with touch or keyboard to see the actual bonus and its possible range.
Compare an item with equipped gear, including level, calling, upgrades and stat differences.
The same details are available in bags, bank storage and auction inspection. Existing item stats and rolls are unchanged.
Auction inspection fits phone screens and keeps the market list available while viewing roll details on desktop.
Waypoints rebuild their route from the landing position after Zeppelin travel, so custom markers do not point back along an old route.

title: Larger tablet controls and profession guides
summary: More comfortable touch controls, readable stamina and clearer guidance for training and updates.
changes: Tablet movement, combat and utility controls are 25% larger by default.
Mobile stamina stays visible above the movement controls, with numbers and ready, sprinting, exhausted or recovering text.

Professions show current and maximum levels. Each profession now has an in-game guide with training advice, resource unlocks, gathering regions and relevant recipes. Resource waypoints remain separate actions.

Settings now explains automatic game updates and when an app-store update is needed. New native app builds can report their installed version and build; older builds explain where to find those details.

title: Choose your wallet when linking
summary: Wallet linking now asks which wallet app to use instead of following the browser preference.
changes: Wallet sign-in and in-game linking now show an explicit wallet chooser, even when only one wallet is detected.
NFTs, the MOSS store, auctions and voucher payouts keep your chosen wallet through the connection and signing steps.
Cancel closes the chooser without opening a wallet request.

title: City training dummies and talent tooltips
summary: Practice attacks and spells in every city, with clearer talent details beside the pointer.
changes: Added a training dummy in each of the six cities, with a handcrafted woodland model and animated reactions to hits.
Training dummies have 100,000 HP, never fall below 1 HP and recover to full health after 10 seconds without damage.
Dummies support attacks and damaging spells, never attack back and give no rewards or kill progress.
Talent tooltips now appear beside the mouse pointer and stay within the screen.

title: Inventory item options
summary: Inspect equipment and manage carried items from their context menu.
changes: Right-click an inventory item to open its options. Equipment also offers Inspect.
Drop permanently destroys one item after confirmation. Starter equipment and equipped items are protected.
Item options also support the keyboard context-menu key and Shift+F10.

title: Regional towns and easier party management
summary: Distinctive regional landmarks, corrected NPC stations and party controls in Friends.
changes: The five regional towns now have distinctive buildings, gardens and animated landmarks, including Amberwild’s harvest windmill and Frostmarch’s ice orrery.
Trainers, mount sellers and town service NPCs now stand at their intended stations.
Manage invitations and party members from the Who tab in Friends. Press P to open Who, or O for Friends.
Fixed roads and markers drawing outside the minimap.

title: Performance indicators and voucher improvements
summary: Optional performance displays, smoother city rendering and clearer voucher payouts.
changes: Settings now offers optional FPS and game-server ping indicators.
Reduced repeated city rendering work and minimap allocations to improve frame consistency.
Voucher payouts complete in the merchant interface once the payout is included, while confirmation continues in the background.

title: Treasure hunts, Asia realm and mobile improvements
summary: Hidden caches and fleeing treasure goblins join the world, with a new realm and mobile fixes.
changes: Find treasure maps in monster loot, follow their clues, uncover hidden caches and defeat their guardians. Expedition progress is saved.
Rare treasure goblins flee when approached. Catch them before they escape for a chance at a MOSS voucher.
Added Asia realm support.
Improved mobile HUD layout, double-tap jumping, actions while moving, starter potion access and wallet sign-in recovery.
